reviewContext.scope: earn/gig COCONALA pivot — round-3 re-review of round-2 FAIL fixes (FIND-001..006)
reviewContext.note: No manifest.json exists for this scope under .vcsdd (Glob confirmed) and no prior coconala-pivot round-1/2 review dir was persisted; reviewed disk-only per the adversary mandate and written to a new scope dir. The Bash tool was NOT available in this context, so `node --test`, `bash -n`, and `WAKE_ID=t bash run.sh` were NOT executed — every verdict is from static reading of the on-disk code/tests, and each round-2 claimed fix was checked against the actual code, not a commit message.

evidence.description: POSITIVE — the core's cron prompt itself is genuinely no-human on manual read: blockers route to autonomous paths (captcha->CapSolver, OTP->gog gmail, login->Googleでログイン), 'A blocker is NOT a stop', and it never asks a human.
POSITIVE — the apply flow is fully automated (real-mouse datepicker, setFileInputFiles attach, 投稿前モーダル) with no human click step.

FAIL — the automated guard that is supposed to ENFORCE no-human on gig-cli.sh is blind on ~60% of the only meaningful line: stripComments deletes everything after 'TRACK #5121769' before the FORBIDDEN scan (see FIND-R3-002). The artifact is no-human today, but the round-2 audit fix does not actually protect the core prompt.

FIND-003 fixed + deterministic: a ¥ row is summed ONLY if status ∈ {検収,支払,検収完了,completed,paid} AND r.get('evidence') is truthy; an applied/in-progress/no-evidence/fabricated row is rejected. earn_usdc is the literal 0 and wallet is null on every run — no USDC origination.
Identical deterministic guard (SETTLED whitelist + non-empty evidence) with an explicit rejected-row counter; monitor never calls record-earn (read-only).
earnSkillRelPath('earn/gig') returns 'earn/gig/run.sh' ('earn/gig' is not a key of EARN_ACTION), so the loop resolves the slot to the NEW honest run.sh — NOT the archived dealwork/USDC run.sh.

The record-earn / on-chain-USDC settle machinery now lives ONLY under archive/ and is not referenced by run.sh, monitor.sh, gig-cli.sh, or the loop resolver — the USDC path is unreachable from the active loop.
FIND-001/002 fixed: the slot resolver finds skills/earn/gig/run.sh (no more skill_missing). The restored run.sh is a cheap honest supervise+report entry (ensure-core-alive + ¥ status).

FIND-005 file deletion done: Glob of skills/earn/gig/** shows producer.sh gone and only ai.anicca.gig-core-healthcheck.plist remains (no producer plist). Core (gig-cli.sh) + healthcheck (gig-healthcheck.sh) + monitor (monitor.sh) all present and internally consistent.
FIND-006 fixed: dealwork artifacts moved to archive/; the active skill dir has no state/ directory (Glob of state/** empty).

MINOR (non-blocking) — PY is hardcoded to /opt/homebrew/bin/python3; if absent the heredoc emits no JSON line. Acceptable for this Mac-local human-funded loop but a portability footgun vs the archived run.sh which used bare `python3`.

The runbook is concrete and proven: real request 5121769 (mtdc account), exact /offers/add/{id} flow, real-mouse datepicker rationale (JS .click() not committed), setFileInputFiles attach with chip verification, 投稿前モーダル final submit, and an E2E verify via tab-title change.
The dealwork->Coconala pivot rationale is real and documented ('Only human accounts can withdraw' for dealwork; Coconala pays real ¥ to Dais MUFG).
A real sample deliverable artifact exists for the tracked request, consistent with the runbook's 'attach a real sample' step.
POSITIVE — FIND-001/002 honesty fix present: the earn/gig summary is ¥/HUMAN-FUNDED/Coconala/Dais MUFG, explicitly 'NO USDC, NO record-earn, no human in the daily op'.
POSITIVE — FIND-004 fixed: NO_HUMAN.md is consistent with the Coconala reality, names archive/ as holding the old USDC machinery, and explicitly retracts the stale 'Coconala removed' note.

FAIL — SLOT_CC.md still advertises 'producer/monitor added' though producer.sh + its plist were deleted; the design spec it points to (2026-06-29-earn-gig-slot-design.md:152,156) still mandates producer.sh + a producer plist + a ~/gig/queue drain that no longer exist. Round-2 FIND-005's 'nothing references them (SLOT_CC, plists)' criterion is not met (see FIND-R3-001).
